title: Work on how
insurance work gets done.
lead: We are a small team in Austin building AI workforces for insurance. The problems are concrete, the customers are real, and the work ships into live brokerage operations.

why.title: What you would be part of.

items.title: Real work, in production
items.body: Desks run against live submissions, carriers and renewals. You see what you build change how a business operates.

items.title: Insurance and engineering, together
items.body: You will sit with people who have run placement and people who have built the systems that do it. Both learn from each other every day.

items.title: Inside the customer’s operation
items.body: Much of the work happens inside customers’ operations: capturing context, connecting systems, earning adoption. Deployment is the product.

items.title: Early, with a foundation
items.body: Third Plane grew out of QuoteWell, so the model was tested before it was sold. You join early without starting from zero.

how.title: Calm, specific, accountable.
items: We say what works today and what we believe will work next, and we keep the two separate.
We write things down: authority, decisions, and the reasons behind them.
We prefer a finished outcome over a demo, and a plain sentence over a slogan.
We are in Austin and we like being in the same room.

roles.title: Roles we are hiring for.
roles.empty: No open roles are listed right now. If you know insurance operations or build AI systems that do real work and want to work on this, write to us anyway.

items.title: Senior Product Manager
items.location: Austin, TX and New York, NY

cta.title: Introduce yourself.
cta.body: Tell us what you have built or what you have run, and what you would want to work on here.
